sections.text: Five-part oracle for `nucleide.unfold`, all parts always run: analytic gates U1-U4 on synthetic forward folds (fold identity, exact fixed point, determined and underdetermined round-trips at pinned tolerances), IRDFF-II analytical benchmark-shape probes U5 (Trkov et al. 2020, published facts with citation), STAYSL-class least-squares gates U9-U13, GRAVEL chi-square-weighted gates U14-U18, and MAXED maximum-entropy gates U19-U23. No external unfolding oracle exists, so no container dependency is added and no check can SKIP.
U2: an exact guess is a fixed point (one confirming no-op adjustment).
U3 determined 6x6 recovery from a 3x-biased guess: 2 adjustments.
U4 underdetermined case (6 detectors, 24 groups): rates reproduced; spectrum error 3.989e-01 vs guess error 1.000e+00 — the recoverable bias component converges, the null-space part keeps the guess.

U5 shapes are the IRDFF-II analytical benchmark fields named in Trkov et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 163 (2020) 1 (arXiv:1909.03336), re-derived from their closed forms; the IAEA-copyright tabulated spectra are never used.
U6-U8: non-convergence raises (never a partial spectrum), unconstrained groups keep the guess bit-exactly, and every malformed input names its cause.

rows: U6 cap is a hard fail

sections.text: U9 determined 6x6 recovery from a 3x-biased guess: 2 cycles; caller-supplied per-detector sigmas are the least-squares weights (a redundant reading with 100x the sigma loses to the precise one).

U10 underdetermined case (6 detectors, 24 groups): the least-squares fixed point interpolates the measured rates (6 cycles). Unlike SAND-II's multiplicative spreading it does not promise a spectrum closer than the guess — weakly constrained group directions take their values from the fit, not the prior — so the gate pins rate reproduction only.

U11 shapes are the IRDFF-II analytical benchmark fields named in Trkov et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 163 (2020) 1 (arXiv:1909.03336), re-derived from their closed forms with group bounds bracketing each shape's support; the IAEA-copyright tabulated spectra are never used.
U12: both methods consume the same fold — once SAND-II has converged, the anchored least-squares cycle about its spectrum is a no-op, so a SAND-II fixed point is a least-squares fixed point too.
U13: non-convergence raises (never a partial spectrum), malformed sigmas name their cause, and unreachable rates are loud.

rows: U12 SAND-II fp is a LS fp

sections.text: U14 determined 6x6 recovery from a 3x-biased guess: 2 adjustments; caller-supplied per-detector sigmas are the chi-square weights (a redundant reading with 100x the sigma loses to the precise one).
U15 underdetermined case (6 detectors, 24 groups) under counting-statistics sigmas: rates reproduced (40529 adjustments), spectrum error 7.744e-01 vs guess error 1.000e+00.

U16 shapes are the IRDFF-II analytical benchmark fields named in Trkov et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 163 (2020) 1 (arXiv:1909.03336), re-derived from their closed forms with group bounds bracketing each shape's support; the IAEA-copyright tabulated spectra are never used.
U17: all three methods consume the same fold — at a fixed point every rate ratio is 1, so the GRAVEL weights are irrelevant and each method holds the others' fixed points after one confirming cycle.
U18: non-convergence raises (never a partial spectrum), malformed sigmas name their cause, and unreachable rates are loud.

rows: U17 SAND-II fp is a GRAVEL fp
U17 GRAVEL fp is a SAND-II fp
U17 GRAVEL fp is a LS fp

sections.text: U19 determined 6x6 recovery from a 3x-biased guess: 20 adjustments; caller-supplied per-detector sigmas are the chi-square weights (a redundant reading with 100x the sigma loses to the precise one).
U20 underdetermined case (6 detectors, 24 groups) under counting-statistics sigmas: rates reproduced (17 adjustments), spectrum error 7.196e-01 vs guess error 1.000e+00.

U21 shapes are the IRDFF-II analytical benchmark fields named in Trkov et al., Nucl. Data Sheets 163 (2020) 1 (arXiv:1909.03336), re-derived from their closed forms with group bounds bracketing each shape's support; the IAEA-copyright tabulated spectra are never used.
U22: both methods consume the same fold — at a fixed point the dual residual is zero, so MAXED holds the SAND-II point (and vice versa) after one confirming adjustment.

U23: non-convergence raises (never a partial spectrum) — both on cap exhaustion and when the chi-square bottoms out above an unreachable target on disagreeing redundant readings; malformed sigmas, targets, and unreachable rates name their cause.

rows: U22 SAND-II fp is a MAXED fp
U22 MAXED fp is a SAND-II fp
